Exercise: Dynamic Back Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- flexion
- extension_of_the_spine

Primary Muscles:

- lats

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_spinal_flexibility
- relieve_lower_back_tension

Contraindications:

- acute back injury

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your arms straight, swing them straight up in front of you 5-10 times, increasing the range of motion each time until your arms are above your head.
